mali.text: Hi! I have twelve minutes before class. I’m deciding whether I can get lunch.
What happened the last time you tried to buy lunch before class?
Yesterday I walked to the noodle stall. The line was much longer than I expected, so I left without lunch. Ask who else shares my short timetable.
Who else shares your short timetable?
My class break is twelve minutes. Other students in my timetable have the same problem. Do you want to hear what happened yesterday?

noa.text: Hello! I look after this stall. What would you like to find out about the lunch rush?
Why does the lunch queue become hard to predict?
We write the queue on the board at opening. It changes during lunch, but the board has no time or quick way to update it. A useful follow-up is who could make a small update while we are busy.

ken.text: Hey! I’m heading to practice. I need to decide where to eat before walking across campus.
What do you need to know before choosing where to eat?
I need to see the queue and when someone checked it. A prediction alone would not tell me if it is still true. Would your first version show when its information was last checked?
